To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the BER performance of π/4-shift differentially encoded quadratue phase shift keying OFDM systems over frequency-selective Rayleigh fading channels with carrier frequency offset can be accurately analyzed with a closed-form exact expression.

the BER performance of OFDM systems using π/4-DPSK is affected by carrier frequency offset over fast frequency selective fading channels, and that the BER performance can be significantly improved by using differential encoding in frequency domain, and/or by using diversity combining techniques.

the exact closed-form expression for the BER can be used to determine the optimum number of subcarrier, and the allowable frequency offset, Dopple spread and mean delay spread, for a π/4-DPSK OFDM system with differential encoding.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and analysis of an OFDM system with π/ 4-DQPS K over frequency-selective wireless fading channels, and the results obtained can provide valuable information to system designers.
an exact BER analysis of a practical wireless OFDM system with π/ 4-DQPSQ in the presence of frequency offset and fast fading.
the design of a π/4-DPSK OFDM system with carrier frequency offset for a more realistic frequency selective fast fading channel environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the exact BER analysis for the π/4-DPSK OFDM system with carrier frequency offset can provide a better insight into the system performance and a better understanding of the effect of the channel parameters on the system performance.
the π/4-DPSK OFDM system can be a promising candidate for high speed wireless communications.

, in general, the system performance with frequency domain differential modulation is superior to that with time domain differential modulation for a large number or subcarriers, and for a small number or subcarbers the two systems are equivalent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a system with π/ 4-DQPSKSOFDM with time domain differential modulation is robust against carrier frequency offset and can be used in a frequency selective fast fading channel with a large Doppler spread and/or a large mean delay spread.

the proposed BER analysis can provide a better understanding of the system design for OFDM systems with π/4-DPSK modulation over frequency selective fast Rayleigh fading channel with frequency offset.
, the BER expression is a very useful tool to evaluate the performance of a π/4-DPSK OFDM system over a fast fading channel with frequency offset.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the exact BER analysis is useful in the design of wireless systems with OFDM, especially when the system is subject to a frequency-selective fast fading channel.

, in a frequency-selective fast fading channel, the performance of π/4DQPSK OFDMA with frequency domain differential modulation is superior to the performance of π/DQPSK OFMDA with time domain differential modulation.

the BER performance of π/4-shift differential quadrature phase shift keyed orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system is significantly degraded by the carrier frequency offset, especially in a frequency-selective fading channel environment.
